newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting higher.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting higher.

text.p: French shares are expected to start higher on Thursday, helped by Wall Street's overnight gains and the FOMC's decision to leave interest rates unchanged.

But gains were seen limited after Wednesday's announcement by the Socialist government that it was considering boosting corporate taxes to ease France's budget woes. The news knocked the market lower on Wednesday.
"I don't think it will rise too much. The market is fragile," said one trader.
The CAC-40 futures contract was up 14 points at 0748 GMT from 2,931.0 on Wednesday. The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 1.17 percent or 34.59 points at 2,909.45.
